skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Tons of Sunshine
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Tons of Sunshine. Clothes Wanqing wears for work. White singlet, tight-fitting yet breathable pants, and a dirt-repellent apron. A simple ensemble that becomes harmony itself on him.
skins.quote: 'Why is it that the crops Wanqing harvests always turn out so good?' 'They don't just get a lot of natural sunlight, they get the light of his pearly whites too. With that much sunshine, how can you not end up tasty as heck?'
